title: Software Development Engineer II (Frontend)
description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

  

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

**Introduction to the Team:**

Expedia Technology teams partner with our Product teams to create innovative products, services, and tools to deliver high-quality experiences for travelers, partners, and our employees. A singular technology platform powered by data and machine learning provides secure, differentiated, and personalized experiences that drive loyalty and traveler satisfaction.

Expedia Group Activities Shopping Experience team is building outstanding experiences for travelers to plan, shop and book activities for their trip. We use personalisation and recommendations to help traveler discover and shop the experiences that suit their travel the most, and help them complete their itinerary. Our team is looking for someone who will drive the innovation and scale of Activities business, by delivering a world-class suite of products & experiences that will delight our travelers, while crafting a working environment where top technical talent will thrive.

  

**In this role, you will:**

* Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain responsive, accessible, and high-quality frontend applications.
* Translate product and design requirements into scalable user interface solutions using modern frontend technologies.
* Contribute to low-level system design, API integration, and data modeling for reliable applications.
* Own frontend features through implementation, testing, deployment, troubleshooting, and operational support.
* Collaborate with engineering, product, design, and technical partners to deliver outcomes across multiple domains.
Safely integrate and operate AI/ML-enabled solutions that improve product and engineering outcomes.  

  

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field; or Equivalent related professional experience.
* 2+ years of relevant professional frontend experience, react etc.
* Experience owning frontend features or components within a service or application from design through deployment and support.
* Proficiency in frontend development, API integration, data modeling, version control, automated testing, debugging, and performance optimization.
Familiarity with AI-driven systems, tools, or workflows and applying AI/ML concepts to real world products.  

  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience building accessible, responsive, performant, and maintainable frontend applications at scale.
* Demonstrated ability to use data and production insights to improve user experience, application reliability, and performance.
* Experience contributing to low-level design and frontend architecture across multiple services or technical domains.
* Experience using AI-assisted development tools or applying AI/ML concepts to improve frontend capabilities and engineering workflows.
* Experience safely integrating, monitoring, and operating AI/ML-enabled features within frontend applications.

**Accommodation requests**

Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service-now.com/askeg?id=job\_accommodation .

  

**About Expedia Group**

Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands - Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo - along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.

  

**Important notice**

Employment opportunities and job offers at Expedia Group will always come from Expedia Group's Talent Acquisition and hiring teams. Never share sensitive personal information unless you are confident of the recipient. Expedia Group does not extend job offers via email or messaging tools to individuals with whom we have not made prior contact. Our email domain is @expediagroup.com. The official place to find and apply for roles is https://careers.expediagroup.com/jobs/ .

  

**Equal Opportunity**

Expedia is committed to creating an inclusive work environment with a diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, disability or age.

title: Senior Software Engineer II (Java, Microservices, React)
description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Design, develop, test, and maintain full-stack applications using modern backend and frontend technologies, delivering reliable, high-performance solutions at enterprise scale
* Build and evolve RESTful APIs and backend services with a focus on security, scalability, and maintainability
* Develop modern, responsive, and accessible user interfaces using contemporary frontend frameworks
* Participate across the full software development lifecycle, including design, implementation, testing, CI/CD, deployment, and production support
* Act as a hands-on engineer, working independently on complex problems and leading by example through high engineering standards
* Troubleshoot complex technical issues, perform root-cause analysis, and implement durable solutions in both development and production environments
* Support application availability, reliability, and stability for business-critical systems, including participation in incident response and operational support
* Collaborate with product management, architecture, QA, and platform teams to translate business requirements and roadmaps into technical solutions
* Contribute to design documentation, technical specifications, and operational runbooks to support long-term maintainability
* Identify gaps, risks, and improvement opportunities within existing systems and propose practical, scalable enhancements
* Collaborate with the team to identify opportunities for AI/ML integration
* Adhere to Agile and Scaled Agile (SAFe) practices, engineering governance, and enterprise service management processes
  
* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor of Science in computer science or related quantitative field
* 8+ years of experience with software engineering and software development life cycle
* 5+ years of experience designing, developing, and supporting Spring Boot-based APIs and backend services
* Hands-on experience in backend software engineering within large-scale enterprise environments
* Experience working in Agile software development environments, collaborating closely with product, engineering, and operations teams
* Experience working with relational databases, including MS SQL
* Experience supporting systems in regulated environments with a solid focus on reliability, security, and compliance, particularly within healthcare or pharmacy domains
* Working knowledge of CI/CD practices and tooling, including GitHub Actions, artifact management, secrets management, and automated quality controls
* Solid proficiency in Java, with demonstrated experience building secure, scalable, and maintainable applications

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with React to build modern, responsive, and accessible user interfaces
* Experience with one of the cloud platforms (Azure, AWS or GCP). Having Azure cloud experience
* Experience with Optum enterprise platforms and tooling, including Skyline
* Experience with Camunda or similar workflow and business process orchestration frameworks
* Experience supporting high-availability, customer-facing platforms in healthcare, pharmacy benefit management, or related regulated industries
* Familiarity with operational excellence practices, including observability, incident management, and production support for mission-critical systems

*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

title: Front-End Engineer III
description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

  

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. **Introduction to the Team:**  
Expedia Technology teams partner with our Product teams to create innovative products, services, and tools to deliver high-quality experiences for travelers, partners, and our employees. A singular technology platform powered by data and machine learning provides secure, differentiated, and personalized experiences that drive loyalty and traveler satisfaction.
  
The Login Experience team is responsible for building and maintaining the traveler sign-in, registration, and account-access experiences across brands like Expedia, Hotels.com , Vrbo, Orbitz, Travelocity and more. As the front door to every traveler's journey, our work directly shapes first impressions and trust — ensuring travelers can sign in and access their accounts quickly, securely, and consistently, no matter which brand or surface they land on. This Frontend/UI Engineer role directly supports execution of committed engineering work, reduces delivery risk, and ensures we can meet key customer, partner, and business objectives within the planned timeline.

  

**In this role, you will:**

* Design and implement high-quality user interfaces and interaction patterns that align with product requirements, design systems, accessibility standards, and performance goals across multiple surfaces and devices.
* Implement robust client-side application architecture, including component composition, state management, routing, and API integration patterns that are scalable and maintainable across multiple product surfaces.
* Collaborate closely with designers, product managers, and backend engineers to refine requirements, validate technical feasibility, identify tradeoffs, and deliver incremental, testable UX improvements backed by data and experimentation.
* Apply strong front-end engineering practices including automated testing, code reviews, performance optimization, security-conscious coding, and observability for web applications at scale.
* Contribute to and consume shared UI component libraries, design systems, and tooling to enable reuse and consistency across teams and projects, ensuring solutions can be adapted for multiple domains.
Demonstrate familiarity with AI-driven systems, tools, or workflows and applying AI/ML concepts to real-world products, and safely integrate and operate AI/ML‑enabled solutions that improve user experience, personalization, and content relevance.  

  

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field; or Equivalent related professional experience.
* 5+ years of relevant professional experience.
* Professional experience developing production-grade web applications using React.js, JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, and CSS, including integration with RESTful or GraphQL APIs.
* Proven experience owning user-facing features end-to-end within a web application, including low-level UI design, implementation, testing, deployment, and operational support in collaboration with cross-functional partners.
Demonstrated skills in front-end system design, including component-level low-level design (LLD), API consumption patterns, and data modeling for view-layer state and client-side data management, within modern engineering ecosystems and tooling (such as package managers, build systems, testing frameworks, and CI/CD pipelines).  

  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience designing and evolving complex React architectures at scale, including patterns for state management, performance tuning, and modularization across multiple products or domains.
* Background in building and extending shared UI component libraries or design systems, and driving adoption of best practices for accessibility, localization, and responsive design across teams.
* Track record of using data and experimentation (A/B tests, analytics, user behavior insights) to inform UX decisions and iteratively improve customer-facing experiences.
* Hands-on experience with AI-augmented developer or UX workflows (for example, code generation assistance, design optimization, or personalized UI experiences), with the ability to safely integrate and operate AI/ML‑enabled capabilities in web applications.
* Experience collaborating with AI/ML and backend teams to design front-end APIs, interaction patterns, and data flows that surface AI-driven personalization, recommendations, or automation in a transparent, responsible, and performant way, including role-specific application of AI/ML concepts to enhance user experience.
